title: Concept: Anchor navigates to a data:text/html document
description: An anchor whose href is a data:text/html document in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The target document inherits an opaque origin but still renders markup that a reader can be tricked into running, and it defeats URL-based blocklists.
applicability: Deployments that render an anchor whose href is a data:text/html document into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The target document inherits an opaque origin but still renders markup that a reader can be tricked into running, and it defeats URL-based blocklists.
